newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Latest Swiss sight deposit drop not unusual - SNB.
newsitem.headline: Latest Swiss sight deposit drop not unusual - SNB.

text.p: A sharp drop in sight desposits at the Swiss National Bank (SNB) in early January was not unusual for the first reporting period of the new year, a central bank spokesman said on Monday.
The bank's latest statement showed sight deposits fell by 1,865.2 million Swiss francs in early January to 3,062.2 million on January 10.
"After the end-of-year period it is not unusual that they fall back so much," the SNB spokesman told Reuters after the statement was issued. "It is business as usual," he added.
Sight deposits held by commercial banks at the SNB are a key measure of liquidity.
